# Richard Stanley

> Personal website of Richard Stanley, Chief Technology Officer of Leyline Lending — a technology leader focused on real estate lending technology, AI/ML, and cloud architecture.

Richard Stanley is a technology leader with software engineering experience architecting globally scalable systems at AWS and Capital One. He holds an MBA from UCLA and a BS from UC Berkeley, and is a licensed loan officer and an AI/ML practitioner. He currently serves as CTO of Leyline Lending.

## Projects

- [MyLeadBuy](https://myleadbuy.com): A leads platform for the real estate lending and sales industry.
- [Miliare Referral Network](https://miliarenetwork.com): A referral network and payment platform enabling 14,000 agents to pass referrals between partner companies that can meet their clients' service needs.
